code_node_service_down: Persona's background service isn't running on this computer. Open Persona Link and let it reinstall.
code_link_offline: This computer is offline: Persona Link isn't running, or the computer is asleep.
code_never_connected: This computer has never connected. Pair it once with its pairing link.
code_node_outdated: Persona on this computer is too old to update from here. Reinstall it on that computer.
err_tls_required: The hub hasn't turned on secure connections, so computers can't connect. Turn them on in the hub's admin page › Network, then try again.
err_mesh_member: This hub is a member of a group. Add computers on the primary hub.
err_too_many_pending: You already have 3 computers that aren't set up yet (some may never have connected). Remove the ones you don't need on the Machines page, then add a new one.
err_forbidden: This device can't add computers. Try from an app or browser that's signed in.
err_invalid_name: Give it a name of up to 40 characters.
